steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize metadata and define the build steps for the Tiny Notes application.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper Android SDK (compile/target 34, min 21) and Gradle build specifications.

steps.title: Design Android Manifest
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml file configuring application settings, correct XML namespaces, and pointing launcher activity to MainActivity.

steps.title: Construct User Interface Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml with clean material UI components for a text editor, status bar, and functional interactive buttons.

steps.title: Define Application Theme
steps.description: Assign default Android Material Light theme in the manifest to ensure consistent rendering across Android versions without using external AppCompat dependencies.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java file, declare required UI elements, and set up state initialization.

steps.title: Implement Storage Persistence
steps.description: Add SharedPreferences logic inside MainActivity.java to save and restore notes automatically across app restarts.

steps.title: Implement Text Watcher & Character Counter
steps.description: Attach a TextWatcher to dynamically count characters of the entered note in real-time.

steps.title: Implement Tap Counter Feature
steps.description: Implement a simple micro-counter feature with increment and reset options to expand the utility of the micro-app.

steps.title: Code Validation
steps.description: Review and validate manifest namespace, activity tags, Java 8 compatibility, and anonymous inner class click listeners.

steps.title: Building Tiny Notes
steps.description: Run the gradle build task to compile assets and generate the debug APK.
